name: lightcraft
notes: Runtime pin read by server/install.mjs (desktop.version) and the shared installer. Pinned 2026-11-04 to the v0.18.0 release (published 2026-11-03). Digests copied from the release's SHA256SUMS.txt and bytes from GitHub asset metadata; all three archives were downloaded and matched both. The DMG holds only LightCraft.app, so macOS also installs the separately pinned lightcraft-cli payload from the same release; the Windows portable ZIP and the Linux tarball carry lightcraft-cli themselves. Licences: the app bundle carries LICENSE-MIT, LICENSE-APACHE and NOTICE under Contents/Resources/Licenses, and the ZIP and tarball carry them at their roots, so no supplemental notice is needed. The control port is still unauthenticated at 0.18.0: the adapter verifies the listening process against the installed release before any request. Exercised at this pin by scripts/extensions/prove-lightcraft-drive.ts on darwin-arm64: clean download, size and SHA-256 check, offline tree validation, codesign, headless import/develop/export and a live window. Download only this URL; never select latest at install time.
